_readme: Samples deployed with the app. Drop audio files next to this file and list them here; they appear in everybody's Sampler library as BUILT IN, are cached offline by the service worker like every other sample, and cannot be deleted from inside the app. 'file' is required and is relative to this folder. 'id' is optional but keeping it stable means a setup that uses the clip survives a rename of the file. Any format the browser can decode works — .wav is exact, .mp3 is smaller.
